title: Access scenario
description: A conformance scenario: a sequence of steps run against one peer that starts holding nothing. Applies a set, restarts the peer, moves its clock, and asks it whether a principal (and, for an agent, the person it acts for) may read a record type in a scope. The same scenarios run against bos's fake peer and against a peer's own enforcement with a stub bos.

requires.description: What the peer must list in its profile for the scenario to apply: grant shapes (field_exclusion, direction_limit, expiry, row_relation, record_grant) or the contract feature record_access. A peer that does not list one skips the scenario.

at.description: Move the peer's clock here before the step.

expect.description: With apply: the outcome the peer must report.

unrepresentable.description: With apply and an applied outcome: the ids of the grants, and of the record entries, the peer must report it cannot express.

restart.description: Stop the peer and start it again. It keeps the last set durably, and what its records stand under, and the time of its last feed catch-up.

feed.description: The peer consumes this change event of the feed (a bos.peer/v1 event), in the order of the steps: upserted, refreshed and scope_changed replace what its subject stands under with data.under (none: not known), deleted and erased drop the record. Needs the feature record_access.

catch_up.description: The peer completes a catch-up of the feed at the step's clock. Record-level reads are denied when the last one is older than policy.record_basis_max_staleness_seconds (or the peer's own limit), or none was done. Needs the feature record_access.

on_behalf_of.description: The person an agent acts for. The peer allows only when both ids are allowed.

sensitivity.description: Effective sensitivity of the record, when classified.

record.description: A read of one record, not a type: the record's address. What it stands under is what the peer holds from the feed steps, unless the check brings it (under, under_truncated). The check's scope, type_key and sensitivity are the record's.

under.description: The addresses the record stands under (data.under of its event), brought by the check instead of held. Absent: what the peer holds; if it holds none it does not know them, and denies.

under_truncated.description: data.under_truncated of its event. True: the peer denies.

excluded.description: With allow: the fields the peer must leave out.
